name: Aurelia Hair Elixir
subtitle: Advanced Botanical Hair Nourishment Oil
tagline: Inspired by Nature. Designed for Healthy-Looking Hair.
shortDescription: A rich botanical oil with 62+ herbs, flowers and nourishing oils that conditions the hair fibre, softens dry hair and brings back a natural-looking shine.
intro: With Rosemary, Hibiscus, Amla, Bhringraj, Fenugreek, Curry Leaves and numerous other botanicals, AURELIA celebrates traditional herbal hair-care practices through an oil-based conditioning experience.

benefits.title: Helps Reduce Hair Breakage
benefits.body: A nourishing blend of Coconut Oil, Castor Oil and Gingelly Oil helps condition the hair fibre, improve manageability and reduce friction during grooming. With regular use, well-conditioned hair may be less prone to breakage caused by dryness and mechanical stress.

benefits.title: Supports a Healthy Scalp Environment
benefits.body: Botanicals such as Rosemary, Neem, Tulsi and Aloe Vera contribute to the formulation's distinctive botanical profile. A well-maintained scalp is an important part of a consistent hair-care routine.

benefits.title: Promotes Hair-Fibre Strength and Conditioning
benefits.body: Lipid-rich oils help coat and lubricate the hair shaft, improving softness and manageability. This conditioning action helps maintain the appearance of stronger, smoother, healthier-looking hair.

benefits.title: Nourishes and Softens Dry Hair
benefits.body: Coconut Oil, Gingelly Oil and Castor Oil provide emollient benefits that help soften dry hair, improve its feel and enhance its natural-looking shine.

benefits.title: Helps Improve Hair Smoothness and Shine
benefits.body: The oil-based formulation helps smooth the hair's outer surface, making strands feel softer and appear glossier. Improved lubrication can also make detangling easier and reduce friction during combing.

benefits.title: Supports the Follicular Microenvironment Through Scalp Care
benefits.body: Healthy hair begins with attention to the scalp. A consistent scalp-care routine can help maintain scalp comfort and conditioning. However, nourishing the scalp externally does not necessarily stimulate dormant follicles or guarantee new hair growth.

benefits.title: Complements a Botanical Hair-Care Ritual
benefits.body: With Rosemary, Hibiscus, Amla, Bhringraj, Fenugreek, Curry Leaves and numerous other botanicals, AURELIA celebrates traditional herbal hair-care practices through an oil-based conditioning experience.

benefits.title: Helps Maintain Manageable, Healthy-Looking Hair
benefits.body: Regular conditioning can help improve the look and feel of dry, rough or difficult-to-manage hair, leaving it softer, smoother and easier to style.

closingTitle: Your hair deserves more than a routine.
closingBody: It deserves thoughtful care, consistent nourishment, and a ritual inspired by the richness of nature.
signature: AURELIA HAIR ELIXIR — Botanical Nourishment for the Beauty of Every Strand.

benefits.title: Rosemary-Inspired Scalp Vitality
benefits.body: Rosemary Oil brings a distinctive botanical character to this advanced serum. Recognised for its aromatic properties and scientific interest in hair-care research, Rosemary adds a sophisticated botanical dimension to your scalp-care ritual.

benefits.title: Refreshing Scalp Experience
benefits.body: Peppermint Oil introduces a distinctive cooling sensation, while Bergamot, Clary Sage and Cedarwood Oils contribute an elegant aromatic profile — a refreshing sensory experience that elevates your hair-care routine into a moment of personal indulgence.

benefits.title: Advanced Lipid-Based Conditioning
benefits.body: Virgin Coconut Oil and Jojoba Oil contribute complementary emollient properties that help lubricate and condition the hair, supporting softness, improving manageability and enhancing the appearance of natural shine.

benefits.title: Botanical Oil Synergy
benefits.body: Every oil contributes its own distinctive character — from the conditioning properties of Coconut and Jojoba to the aromatic complexity of Rosemary, Peppermint, Bergamot, Clary Sage and Cedarwood.

benefits.title: Your Daily Ritual of Hair Confidence
benefits.body: Healthy-looking hair is built through consistency, thoughtful grooming and the right care routine. HAIR RENAISSANCE complements this journey with a sophisticated oil-based serum designed to support smooth, manageable, well-conditioned hair.

closingTitle: Your hair. Your confidence. Your renaissance.
closingBody: Let every strand reflect the care you give it. Embrace a routine inspired by botanical richness, refined through cosmetic science, and created for those who believe that self-care is an expression of elegance.
signature: HAIR RENAISSANCE — Where Botanical Oils Meet the Art of Beautiful Hair.

name: Scalp Elixir
subtitle: Advanced Active-Infused Scalp & Hair Serum
shortDescription: An advanced, active-infused scalp serum uniting Procapil™, Redensyl®, Anagain™, Caffeine, amino acids and botanical extracts for the appearance of fuller, healthier-looking hair.
intro: SCALP ELIXIR unites innovative cosmetic ingredients, botanical extracts, amino acid technology and scalp-conditioning agents in one sophisticated formulation — designed around a science-inspired approach to scalp care.

benefits.title: Advanced Follicular Care
benefits.body: Specialised cosmetic actives, including Procapil and Redensyl, are selected for their use in advanced hair-care formulations designed to support the appearance of stronger, fuller-looking hair.

benefits.title: Redensyl® — Active-Inspired Hair Care
benefits.body: Redensyl is a specialised cosmetic active developed for hair-care applications, giving SCALP ELIXIR an advanced formulation identity centred on the appearance of hair density.

benefits.title: Anagain™ & Botanical Innovation
benefits.body: Anagain is a plant-derived cosmetic active associated with pea sprout extract. Combined with Fenugreek, Hibiscus and Red Onion Extract, it adds a botanical dimension to this advanced scalp-care formulation.

benefits.title: Caffeine-Powered Scalp Care
benefits.body: Caffeine (1,3,7-trimethylxanthine) adds another dimension to SCALP ELIXIR's active-ingredient profile, reflecting the growing scientific interest in caffeine-based topical hair-care formulations.

benefits.title: Amino Acid Technology & Hair-Fibre Conditioning
benefits.body: Prodew 500 Amino Acid Blend and D-Panthenol complement the formulation with conditioning and moisture-supporting properties, while Vegetable Glycerine helps attract and retain moisture.

benefits.title: A Refined Scalp Environment
benefits.body: Tea Tree and Rosemary Essential Oils contribute a distinctive botanical character. Combined with its water-based formulation, SCALP ELIXIR offers a modern approach to everyday scalp care.

benefits.title: Your Journey Towards Fuller-Looking Hair
benefits.body: A consistent hair-care routine is an important part of maintaining healthy-looking hair. SCALP ELIXIR brings together advanced cosmetic actives, botanical extracts and conditioning technology for a more sophisticated hair-care journey.

closingBody: A new era of scalp care — for people seeking a more sophisticated approach to their hair-care journey.
signature: SCALP ELIXIR — Advanced Actives. Botanical Intelligence. A New Era of Scalp Care.

benefits.title: Neem-Inspired Botanical Scalp Care
benefits.body: Neem Oil brings traditional botanical inspiration to the formulation, complementing the nourishing properties of the cream's rich oils and butters.

name: Lumière Purify Shampoo

benefits.title: Dandruff-Focused Scalp Cleansing
benefits.body: A cleansing system with Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine and Alpha Olefin Sulfonate helps remove excess oil, impurities and accumulated scalp residue, along with visible loose flakes.

benefits.title: Green Tea — Botanical Antioxidant Care
benefits.body: Green Tea Extract contains naturally occurring polyphenols, including catechins, that have attracted scientific interest for their antioxidant properties.

benefits.title: Neem — Traditional Botanical Care
benefits.body: Neem has a long history of use in traditional personal-care practices and contributes to the formula's plant-inspired identity.

benefits.title: Bhringraj — Herbal Hair-Care Heritage
benefits.body: Bhringraj is a recognised botanical in traditional Indian hair-care practices, reflecting our philosophy of drawing on botanical heritage with contemporary formulation technology.

benefits.title: Moisture & Scalp Comfort
benefits.body: Vegetable Glycerine helps attract and retain moisture, Panthenol contributes conditioning properties and Aloe Vera Hydrosol complements the formula's moisture-focused profile.

benefits.title: A Fresh Start for Your Hair
benefits.body: By helping remove everyday impurities and visible loose flakes, this shampoo contributes to a cleaner-feeling scalp and hair that looks refreshed and well-maintained.

closingTitle: A clearer scalp. A fresher feel. A more confident you.
closingBody: Make every wash part of a consistent routine that places scalp hygiene, comfort and hair conditioning at the centre of your self-care journey.
signature: LUMIÈRE PURIFY — Botanical Scalp Care. Refined Cleansing. Everyday Confidence.

benefits.title: Advanced Hair Conditioning
benefits.body: BTMS-50 helps improve hair softness, reduce static and make strands easier to detangle. With Cetyl Alcohol, it creates a rich conditioning texture.

benefits.title: Intensive Hair Smoothening
benefits.body: Argan, Avocado and Castor Oils help lubricate the hair fibre and improve its surface feel, reducing friction between strands for a smoother, softer finish.

benefits.title: Frizz Control & Manageability

benefits.title: Lipid-Rich Hair Nourishment

benefits.title: Detangling & Breakage Care
